name: Hilton Tokyo Bay
accessSummary: Free shuttle bus from JR Maihama Station to the hotel: about 7 min / Disney Resort Line Bayside Station: about 1 min on foot or by the hotel's free shuttle bus (monorail from Maihama Station to Bayside Station: about 4 min)

ops.parking: The hotel has a parking lot for 350 cars. For weddings and banquets it is free for up to 5 hours, then 1,000 yen (tax included) per 60 minutes. For overnight stays it is 4,000 yen per night (from 15:00 on the check-in day until 30 minutes after check-out). The FAQ also mentions a temporary parking lot on the hotel grounds.
ops.catering: The FAQ answers "Can you do catering?" with "Yes, we will propose options to suit the purpose and scale." Year-end parties, New Year parties, thank-you parties, farewell and welcome parties, and chartered bus arrangements are likewise proposed to suit the purpose and scale.
ops.restaurants: The hotel's restaurants are forest garden (buffet), silva (bar lounge), Dynasty (Chinese cuisine), lounge O, bean by the bay (cafe), Garden Pool Restaurant (seasonal) and Acendo. At Garden Poolside, a banquet space, private-use barbecue is also possible. IKSPIARI, next to Maihama Station, is introduced as a shopping place in the official FAQ.
ops.waitingRooms: The hotel states that the small banquet rooms (ami, evo, neo and vio on 2F, 75㎡ each; azur and cyan, 88㎡ each; and Attesa, 80㎡, in the separate building) are also suited to use as waiting rooms or event offices.
